definitions.gloss: onset of illness; developing a disease; falling ill
definitions.explanation: The point at which symptoms of a disease first appear or when a person becomes ill.

examples.japanese: {発病|はつびょう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}った→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Three days have passed since the onset of illness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}して→感染する：26931_kansensuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{発病|はつびょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個人差|こじんさ}→個人差：11654_kojinsa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The period from infection to onset of illness varies by individual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発病|はつびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦できれば→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: If the onset of illness can be detected early, treatment becomes more effective.

notes:
Used in medical and health contexts to describe the moment a disease manifests. The word focuses on the transition from a healthy or latent state to having active symptoms, not on the overall experience of being sick.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発病|はつびょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop an illness; to fall ill
- {発病|はつびょう}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: incidence rate
- {発病|はつびょう}⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧: risk of developing a disease
- {発病|はつびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time of onset
- {発病|はつびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent the onset of illness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発症|はっしょう}→発症：09016_hasshou⟧: onset of symptoms — very close in meaning but more clinical; emphasizes symptoms rather than the illness itself
- {罹患|りかん}: contracting a disease — focuses on the fact of being affected, used in epidemiology
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get sick — everyday expression; less formal than {発病|はつびょう}
